responsibility: Declares the command-line target options specific to the Xstormy16 port for GCC’s option-processing machinery. In this module it defines the msim target switch, which is consumed by the port’s driver/link specifications to select simulator-oriented library linkage rather than changing RTL code generation directly.
same_name_distinction: Defines the Stormy16 target option table for GCC’s option machinery, here the msim switch used by the port’s specs to choose simulator libraries. Unlike stormy16.h, stormy16.cc, and stormy16.md, it does not describe the architecture, implement backend logic, or encode RTL instruction patterns; it only declares target-specific command-line options.
